harnessRecommendation: After viewport breakpoint changes or menu visibility changes, allow newly triggered prefetch requests to complete before an intentional cross-document goto or page/context close.
Track all pending fetch/request lifecycle and navigation boundaries; use bounded completion/quiet waits and fail on timeouts rather than ignoring errors.
Keep native icon readiness checks and preserve raw failures. Do not introduce any GET/asset/path-based ERR_ABORTED exception.

For any proposed lifecycle-only diagnosis retain exact request identity, headers, old/new frame/document context, navigation timing, response and requestfinished/body evidence. Do not substitute a separate HTTP200 GET.
Complete the entire required Pages suite afresh after harness correction; report first run FAIL and subsequent retest separately.
rscGetIndependent.finalConclusion: Initial B01 remains FAIL. Three GETs align exactly with deliberate document navigation and plausibly reflect a harness race; successful GET completion was not proven. One HEAD is a separate greedy cross-document tree-correlation issue. No application defect proven and no blanket abort exclusion justified.
